metadata.methods_description: 64-channel BrainVision actiCHamp EEG was recorded in an unshielded room with participants seated 85 cm from an EIZO monitor; responses were collected with a Cedrus RB-530 box. A block design presented Physical, Imagery, Literal and Metaphorical cue tasks with counterbalanced order. Data were band-pass filtered (0.1-45 Hz, 4th order IIR Butterworth), re-referenced to the average of the mastoids (TP9, TP10), and ocular components were removed with ICA. Epochs span 1.87 s before to 3.17 s after target onset.

funding.award_title: PROcessing MEtaphors: Neurochronometry Acquisition and Decay (PROMENADE)
